question: Can recent-year calibration improve retrospective annual fatal-versus-injury collision probability scores relative to an unchanged expanding-history logistic model?
population: All severity-eligible candidate collisions in selected official NCDB 1999–2021 annual releases; no feature-completeness exclusion; conditional on recorded fatal/injury collision.
eligibility: severity_eligible=true and binary unchanged is_fatal; all supported feature states retained; restrict fitting and evaluation to 1999–2019.
chronology: Within each fold train, calibration and evaluation candidate keys are disjoint. Earlier evaluation years can enter training/calibration of later folds; six folds are statistically dependent. Every evaluation collision appears once across folds.

encoding.method: dictionary-fixed one-hot encoding; drop exactly the declared reference per feature; sparse float64 matrix
encoding.out_of_domain: Reject the run before fitting or scoring, including null, blank, conflicting or undocumented codes; preserve immutable prepared inputs for investigation.
encoding.sentinels: Preserve dictionary-supported unknown U/UU, other Q/QQ and unavailable X/XX as distinct levels; no imputation, pooling or complete-case deletion.
encoding.train_unobserved: Keep supported dictionary column; training-zero columns have neutral zero coefficient and are flagged in coefficient and score-support evidence. Report test/validation occurrence separately; a neutral coefficient is lack of training evidence, not demonstrated absence of association.

base_fit_policy: Fit one new base logistic model and constant training prevalence per fold using training labels only, identical frozen design and settings to original baseline. No pooled-fold model fitting or class weighting. Use decision_function logit z directly; do not recover z from clipped probabilities.

sigmoid.positive_slope: Strictly increasing transformation; a >= 1e-6 preserves theoretical ranking. Numerical ties can affect reported ranking scores.

calibration_fit.data: Exactly the two declared calibration years per fold, labels and base logits only; never evaluation labels. Equal collision weight; no weighting, resampling, penalty or smoothing.
calibration_fit.objective: Mean of logaddexp(0,eta)-y*eta using float64. eta=z+delta or a*z+b. Analytic mean gradients: mean(expit(eta)-y) for intercept; [mean((expit(eta)-y)*z), mean(expit(eta)-y)] for sigmoid.

acceptance.projected_gradient_definition: Interior/unbounded parameter: raw derivative; parameter at its lower bound (within 1e-10): min(raw derivative,0). Positive derivative at lower slope bound satisfies minimization KKT.

calibration_fit.failure_policy: Fail and report the run; do not substitute an optimizer, loosen tolerances, change bounds or silently drop a fold. Any change requires a new protocol version before rerun.

prevalence_comparator.probability: Training fatal count divided by training collision count, constant for both calibration and evaluation rows in that fold.

metrics.primary: Unweighted arithmetic mean of six evaluation-year binary natural-log log losses (macro by year), each computed per collision with float64-epsilon probability clipping.
metrics.average_precision: Recall-step weighted precision, not trapezoidal PR area; higher is better.
metrics.roc_auc: Probability ranking AUC; higher is better. Undefined one-class ranking measures are null.
metrics.observed_expected_ratio: sum(y)/sum(p); null if sum(p)=0. Values above 1 indicate aggregate underprediction.
metrics.aggregation: Report six annual rows per candidate and comparator. Macro mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across years for defined numeric metrics; sample SD is descriptive, never a confidence interval. Also report pooled evaluation scores, clearly labeled collision-weighted; pooled ranking need not equal macro ranking or be unchanged by fold-specific monotone transforms.
metrics.calibration_partition_metrics: Report calibration-year pooled scores per fold as in-sample calibration diagnostics, never method-selection evidence.

reliability.empty_bins: Retain with count 0 and null averages.
reliability.ece: Weighted absolute bin difference, sum((n_bin/n)*abs(observed-mean_prediction)); descriptive/bin-dependent, not a selection criterion.

sparse_rule.action: Flag and retain; no stable subgroup ranking or mechanistic interpretation.

support_reporting.quality_groups: Per evaluation year, each feature separately: stated, unknown U/UU, other Q/QQ, unavailable X/XX; retain zero-support groups with undefined/null rates. Other is not missing. Also collision-level any-unknown and any-other availability groups (flags can overlap), with absence/presence denominators explicitly labeled.
support_reporting.quality_metrics: Candidate/comparator probability and ranking scores with group n/fatal count and sparse flag. Empty or one-class groups have undefined ranking metrics, never silently zeroed.

selection.evidence: Six annual evaluation scores only; this is developmental method selection on already-inspected historical years, not independent testing.
selection.eligible_recommendation: Relative to unchanged: macro log_loss improvement strictly greater than 1e-10, at least four of six evaluation years with log_loss improvement strictly greater than 1e-10, and macro Brier no greater than unchanged plus 1e-10.
selection.rule: Among eligible calibrated methods choose lowest macro log_loss; methods within 1e-10 of the minimum are ties, resolved in complexity order unchanged, intercept_only, sigmoid. If no calibrated method is eligible retain unchanged. Report raw score ranking independently of this recommendation.

prohibitions: No 2020–2021 scoring, calibration, selection, threshold changes or fresh-test claims. Previously evaluated years are not pristine holdouts.
No threshold search or operational threshold recommendation.
No new predictors, interactions, tree challengers, hyperparameter searches or group-specific calibration.
No model-score/parameter confidence intervals promised; fold-to-fold sample SD is not uncertainty coverage.
No accident-occurrence, individual mortality, causal effect or deployment-readiness claim.
acceptance: Frozen input fingerprints and upstream passed receipts verified before fitting and unchanged at completion.
Exact six chronological folds and all eligible collision keys, target, domains and reference levels independently checked.
Training-only prevalence and converged training-only logistic coefficients reconstructed independently.
Calibration parameters, objectives, projected gradients, positive slope and two-year-only fitting independently verified.
Finite probabilities in [0,1]; eval coverage and every annual score, calibration bin and recommendation reconciled independently.
limitations: All six evaluation years were previously inspected during descriptive analysis and prior baseline development; this is a new frozen developmental experiment, not pristine external validation.
Source and reporting changes can alter observed case mix; annual changes do not identify a causal mechanism.
Candidate collisions represent recorded fatal/injury collisions with release-scoped identities.
No exposure denominator, prospective feature-availability verification or independent contemporary event dataset.
Expanded historical training windows overlap and share calibration/evaluation history across folds; six annual scores are dependent.
amendment_policy: Do not edit this protocol after any fit. New post-freeze methodological choices require a separately versioned file and explicit disclosure of results already inspected.
